title: Alert
description: Security incident and anomaly alert schema per UDT-X Section 11 specification.

alert_id.description: Unique identifier for the alert incident.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the alert was triggered.

flow_id.description: Associated FlowEvent ID (or null if correlated across multiple flows).

src_ip.description: Source IP address associated with the threat.

dst_ip.description: Destination / Target IP address associated with the threat.

protocol.description: Network protocol used in the malicious or anomalous communication.

threat_class.description: Categorization of threat (e.g., c2_beaconing, dns_tunneling, data_exfiltration, port_scan, lateral_movement, ddos).

severity.description: Severity rating of the detected threat.

confidence.description: Statistical or model confidence score (0.0 to 1.0).

evidence.description: Structured forensic evidence artifacts supporting the alert.

key.description: Feature or metric name (e.g. entropy, periodicity_score, packet_size_stddev, ja3_reputation).

threshold.description: Expected or baseline threshold that was violated.

description.description: Human-readable interpretation of this evidence piece.

mitre.description: Mapped MITRE ATT&CK tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).

tactic.description: MITRE ATT&CK tactic (e.g., Command and Control, Exfiltration, Discovery).

technique_id.description: MITRE technique identifier (e.g., T1071.004, T1041, T1046).

technique_name.description: MITRE technique name (e.g., DNS Tunneling, Exfiltration Over C2 Channel).

url.description: Reference URL to the MITRE ATT&CK matrix.

title.description: Concise human-readable title for the alert.

description.description: Detailed explanation of the observed anomaly or threat pattern.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the Alert schema.
